6106-definitions-essays-in-contemporary-.creator: Unknown
6106-definitions-essays-in-contemporary-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The Oriental may be inscrutable, but he is no more puzzling than the average American. We admit that we are hard, keen, practical, --the adjectives that every casual European applies to us,--and yet any book-store window or railway news-stand will show that we prefer sentimental magazines and books. Why should a hard race--if we are hard--read soft books?

arxiv-2205-00724.title: Dynamic Qubit Routing with CNOT Circuit Synthesis for Quantum Compilation
arxiv-2205-00724.creator: Arianne Meijer - van de Griend, Sarah Meng Li
arxiv-2205-00724.description: Abstract Many quantum computers have constraints regarding which two-qubit operations are locally allowed. To run a quantum circuit under those constraints, qubits need to be mapped to different quantum registers, and multi-qubit gates need to be routed accordingly. Recent developments have shown that compiling strategies based on Steiner tree provide a competitive tool to route CNOTs.

arxiv-2210-03932.title: A Finite Algorithm for the Realizabilty of a Delaunay Triangulation
arxiv-2210-03932.creator: Akanksha Agrawal, Saket Saurabh, Meirav Zehavi
arxiv-2210-03932.description: Abstract The Delaunay graph of a point set P ⊆ ℝ 2 P\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{2} is the plane graph with the vertex-set P P and the edge-set that contains { p , p ′ } \{p,p^{\prime}\} if there exists a disc whose intersection with P P is exactly { p , p ′ } \{p,p^{\prime}\} .

arxiv-2306-08955.title: A comparison of self- and semi-supervised pretraining approaches for risk prediction from chest radiograph images
arxiv-2306-08955.creator: Yanru Chen 1,2, Michael T Lu 1, Vineet K Raghu 1
arxiv-2306-08955.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yanru Chen 1,2, Michael T Lu 1, Vineet K Raghu 1. Deep learning is the state-of-the-art for medical imaging tasks, but requires large, labeled datasets. For risk prediction (e.g., predicting risk of future cancer), large datasets are rare since they require both imaging and long-term follow-up. However, the release of publicly available imaging data with diagnostic labels presents an opportunity for self and semi-supervised approaches to use diagnostic labels to improve label efficiency for risk prediction.

arxiv-2312-14203.title: Shai: A large language model for asset management
arxiv-2312-14203.creator: Zhongyang Guo, Guanran Jiang, Zhongdan Zhang, Peng Li, Zhefeng Wang, Yinchun Wang
arxiv-2312-14203.description: Abstract This paper introduces ”Shai” a 10B level large language model specifically designed for the asset management industry, built upon an open-source foundational model. With continuous pre-training and fine-tuning using a targeted corpus, Shai demonstrates enhanced performance in tasks relevant to its domain, outperforming baseline models.

arxiv-2512-22455.title: AFA-LoRA: Enabling Non-Linear Adaptations in LoRA with Activation Function Annealing
arxiv-2512-22455.creator: Jiacheng Li, Jianchao Tan, Zhidong Yang, Feiye Huo, Yerui Sun, Yuchen Xie, Xunliang Cai
arxiv-2512-22455.description: Abstract Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely adopted parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method. However, its linear adaptation process limits its expressive power. This means there is a gap between the expressive power of linear training and non-linear training. To bridge this gap, we propose AFA-LoRA, a novel training strategy that brings non-linear expressivity to LoRA while maintaining its seamless mergeability.

arxiv-2601-07844.title: From Agent-Based Markov Dynamics to Hierarchical Closures on Networks: Emergent Complexity and Epidemic Applications
arxiv-2601-07844.creator: Entropy 2026, 28(1), 63
arxiv-2601-07844.description: Abstract We explore a rigorous formulation of agent-based SIR epidemic dynamics as a discrete-state Markov process, capturing the stochastic propagation of infection or an invading agent on networks. Using indicator functions and corresponding marginal probabilities, we derive a hierarchy of evolution equations that resembles the classical BBGKY hierarchy in statistical mechanics.

pmc-10707473.description: This study considers 12 pervious concrete mixes incorporating 100% recycled coarse aggregate from old concrete demolition waste and containing various amounts of natural fine aggregate and date palm leaves fibers. pmc-11489123.title: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder after post appendectomy peritonitis: A case report
pmc-11489123.creator: Muhammad Zaid, Fatima Saleemi, Rana Muhammad Usama, Ayman Tahir, Aima Azhar, Mohammed Mahmmoud Fadelallah Eljack, Muhammad Junaid Tahir
pmc-11489123.description: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD), also known as “Devic's syndrome”, is an autoimmune demyelination disorder. It affects the optic nerve and spinal cord, causing optic neuritis and transverse myelitis. It is associated with anti-aquaporin 4 antibodies that target the aquaporin channel on astrocytes.

pmc-12533504.title: Optimizing patient positioning for exoscopic cranial surgery
pmc-12533504.creator: Paul M. Harary, David J. Park, Steven D. Chang, Michael Schulder, Miguel Sáez-Alegre, Christian Ríos-Vicil, Keaton Piper, Edinson Najera, Walter C. Jean
pmc-12533504.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). We commend the authors for their presentation of a range of posterior fossa surgeries performed using the exoscope, which we agree offers several advantages in comparison with the operating microscope and endoscope in this setting. As noted by the authors, however, there remain challenges in the use of an exoscope, namely its positioning and manipulation, that may hinder its broader adoption. We propose that exoscopic cranial surgeries may be further improved by reconsidering traditional patient positioning to address these issues.

pmc-12562205.title: The Effect of Retention Time and Seasonal Variation on the Characterization of Phyto-Remediated Aquaculture Wastewater in a Constructed Wetland
pmc-12562205.creator: Shadrach A Akadiri, Pius O O Dada, Adekunle A Badejo, Olayemi J Adeosun, Akinwale T Ogunrinde, Oluwaseun T Faloye, Viroon Kamchoom, Oluwafemi E Adeyeri, Guangxu Zhu, Ruiyu Lin, Rongfei Wei
pmc-12562205.description: Simple SummaryThis study investigates the effectiveness and efficiency of macrophyte plants (Phragmites karka and Typha latifolia in removing heavy metals and some nutrients from aquaculture wastewater in a constructed wetland. Raw and treated wastewater from constructed wetlands were collected and analyzed using standard laboratory procedures for the determination of physicochemical properties and heavy metals.

pmc-12719641.title: Anti-Inflammatory Combinations Targeting Oncostatin M Gene to Remodel Intestinal Flora and Alleviate Inflammation of Perianal Ulcer in Rats
pmc-12719641.creator: Yanlan Wu, Hao Ge, Haoran Zhao, Kaiping Zou, Pei Wang, Yi Wang, Yang Zhang
pmc-12719641.description: BackgroundPerianal Abscess is an inflammatory disease caused by infection in the perianal area, characterized by inflammatory cell infiltration and imbalance of intestinal flora. The herbal medicine anti-inflammatory combination (KYHJ) has therapeutic effects in acute and chronic soft tissue infections, but the specific therapeutic mechanism in perianal inflammatory diseases is unclear.

pmc-13005095.title: Longitudinal Trajectories of Cortical Folding in Schizophrenia Spectrum Disorders: A 13-Year Follow-Up Study
pmc-13005095.creator: Lara A Martini, Laura A Wortinger, Claudia Barth, Pravesh Parekh, Kjetil N Jørgensen, Lena Palaniyappan, Daniela Mier, Erik G Jönsson, Ingrid Agartz, Stener Nerland
pmc-13005095.description: Background and HypothesisAltered cortical folding is a well-established finding in schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SSD). Patients with SSD have been hypothesized to exhibit an accelerated decline in age-related cortical folding, quantified with the local gyrification index (LGI). Here, we assessed longitudinal and cross-sectional LGI differences in patients with chronic SSD relative to healthy controls across 13 years.

pmc-13185368.title: Older caregivers and care recipients in Europe: a cluster analysis according to health and social outcomes
pmc-13185368.creator: Alba Ayala, Maider Mateo-Abad, Amaya Bernal-Alonso, Diego Sánchez-González, Fermina Rojo-Perez, Gloria Fernandez-Mayoralas, Maria João Forjaz, Carmen Rodríguez-Blázquez
pmc-13185368.description: BackgroundThe deficit of long-term care workers has intensified reliance on informal care, often provided by older adults, reflecting the demographic changes taking place in Europe. Both caregivers and care recipients in this context tend to share a deterioration in their health, well-being, functional limitations and increased social isolation.

pmc-13354445.title: Colonic diverticular disease: a bibliometric and visual analysis of the top 50 cited publications
pmc-13354445.creator: Raseel B. Almutairi, Batool Y. Altayeb, Ibrahim A. Alsinan, Yara A. Alorfi, Reema H. Almuneef, Taghred J. Aljohani, Abdulaziz A. Alhumam, Zaid A. Dajani, Abdullah E. Alsubhi, Khalifa A. Almulhim
pmc-13354445.description: Colonic diverticular disease (CDD) is a prevalent gastrointestinal condition with evolving patterns in diagnosis, management, and research focus. However, no prior study has systematically mapped the academic literature shaping the field. This bibliometric and visual analysis aims to identify and evaluate the 50 most-cited publications on CDD.

pmc-13490372.title: Polymer-stabilized amorphous CuO–ZnO hybrid nanocomplex as a promising candidate for antimicrobial therapy and controlled drug delivery with molecular docking insights
pmc-13490372.creator: Ecem Isiksel, Azade Attar, Emre Aktaş, Melda Altikatoglu Yapaoz
pmc-13490372.description: In this study, multifunctional polymer-stabilized CuO–ZnO hybrid nanocomplexes were developed through a green synthesis approach and systematically evaluated for their antimicrobial and protein delivery potential. Bimetallic CuO–ZnO nanoparticles were biosynthesized using extracts of Cotoneaster horizontalis, Salvia officinalis, and Laurus nobilis, followed by integration into chitosan/nanochitosan–P(MMA-co-MAA) copolymer matrices.
